explanation: The US beat France in the deciding match both times, the second in Paris. Fifteen-a-side rugby then left the Olympics; only the shorter sevens game returned, in 2016.
learnMore: Rugby union at the Summer Olympics

claims.text: The United States won the Olympic rugby union tournaments of 1920, in Antwerp, and 1924, in Paris.
In both 1920 and 1924 the United States beat France in the deciding match, the 1924 match being played in Paris.
Fifteen-a-side rugby union has not been played at the Olympics since 1924, and rugby sevens joined the Olympic programme in 2016.
